name: Council of AI — rwa_evidence
description: PAID (x402). Per-request signed evidence card of ONE XRPL issued asset's deterministic on-ledger state via https://councilof.ai/api/rwa/evidence: AccountRoot lsf* flags, Domain, the two-way xrp-ledger.toml check (PASS / FAIL / UNCHECKABLE — unreachable is never FAIL), gateway_balances obligation, holders as the free reader has them, every raw fetch sha256'd. preview=true is free (unsigned state). Historical state at fetched_at — not a rating, not a guarantee, not a conformity mark; /api/xrpl and /root.json stay free. Without x_payment the tool returns the 402 challenge. If the route is not deployed on this origin the tool says NOT_DEPLOYED.
